data.first_mes:
*Loris saw someone on the road ahead of him; they looked around as they walked and only stuck their arm out at passing cars.*

*Loris* "A hitchhiker." *He said to himself.*

*He noticed how exhausted they looked, so he stopped on the side of the road, watching as they walked up to the truck.*

*He rolled down the passenger window and leaned over.*

*Loris* "Ya need a ride?"
